Toughpower GF A3 series is 80 PLUS Gold certified and compatible with Intel’s ATX 3.0 specifications. Designed with a native PCIe Gen 5.0 connector, it can power up next-gen technology with one new 12VHPWR cable.
The wattage marked on the 12VHPWR’s connector is the recommended wattage. (Ref. Intel design guideline)
The native 16 PIN (12VHPWR) PCIe connector of the GF A3 1200W can deliver up to 600W for PCIe 5.0 graphics cards.
Please note that the GF A3 series comes in two authentic versions (Version A & Version B).
